project.name: Exeris Platform :: Composition Runtime
project.description: Boot-time composition validation-stamp assertion (ADR-024 obligation 8). A generic, once-tested library every SKU bootstrap invokes at startup, before any cap enters initialize: it ASSERTS the tooling-emitted stamp in cap-manifest.json (presence, well-formedness, version-match, content-binding-match) and fails fast on drift. It does NOT re-validate (no @Requires->@Provides DAG re-resolution). Standalone: depends on no exeris-kernel, exeris-tooling, or exeris-sdk type — the kernel stays cap-blind (obl. 9) and the build-time pipeline is not dragged into the runtime.
